title: Override localDayClockProvider in track_detail_screen_test.dart to remove its wall-clock dependency

evidence.quote:
userDatabaseProvider.overrideWith((ref) => db),
    // Goal writes go through goalRepositoryProvider,

why: TrackDetailScreen reads localDayClockProvider via _trackPaceCalcProvider (default = SystemLocalDayClock, real DateTime.now()). track_detail_screen_test.dart's _overridesFor list never overrides it, while every sibling file that mounts the same screen in this batch (track_detail_goal_stale_test.dart, edit_track_and_detail_l1_test.dart) does, with FakeLocalDayClock pinned to 2026-05-30. No current assertion in track_detail_screen_test.dart depends on paceCalc's output, so this isn't flaky today, but it's one inconsistent override away from date-dependent flakiness the moment someone adds an assertion that touches TrackInfoCard's pace-derived text (days-remaining, projected finish), and it's inconsistent with the established pattern in the same directory.
recommendation: Add localDayClockProvider.overrideWithValue(FakeLocalDayClock(DateTime.utc(2026, 5, 30))) (or another fixed date) to _overridesFor, matching the sibling files.
acceptance_criteria: track_detail_screen_test.dart's _overridesFor includes a localDayClockProvider override with a fixed date
